## Changelog

### Unwaxed Sign

- `Added` a custom particle effect when removing wax from signs

### Composter+

- `Added` more compostable items

| Item                |                       Success Chance |
| ------------------- | -----------------------------------: |
|                     | <div align="center"><b>30%</b></div> |
| Egg                 |                                  30% |
| Brown Egg           |                                  30% |
| Blue Egg            |                                  30% |
| Turtle Egg          |                                  30% |
|                     | <div align="center"><b>65%</b></div> |
| Paper               |                                  65% |
| Leather Horse Armor |                                  65% |
| Leather Helmet      |                                  65% |
| Leather Chestplate  |                                  65% |
| Leather Leggings    |                                  65% |
| Leather Boots       |                                  65% |
|                     | <div align="center"><b>85%</b></div> |
| Book                |                                  85% |
| Slime Block         |                                  85% |
| Magma Block         |                                  85% |

### Cauldron+

- `Added` support for washing potions off tipped arrows
- `Added` support for additional blocks and items introduced alongside the Minecraft update

| Item            | Dye                 | Clean                 |
| --------------- | ------------------- | --------------------- |
| Wool Slab       | `#` Wool Slab       | White Wool Slab       |
| Wool Stairs     | `#` Wool Stairs     | White Wool Stairs     |
| Concrete Slab   | `#` Concrete Slab   | White Concrete Slab   |
| Concrete Stairs | `#` Concrete Stairs | White Concrete Stairs |
| Cushion         | `#` Cushion         | White Cushion         |
| Candle          | `#` Candle          | Candle                |

> **Notes**
>
> - `#` represents any of the 16 supported dye colors\
> - Concrete Powder hardens into Concrete when dyed or cleaned

### Hardens Concrete Powder

- `Added` support for using Potions to harden Concrete Powder into Concrete
- Splash Potions can harden multiple Concrete Powder blocks within their area of effect
- Lingering Potions can continuously harden Concrete Powder blocks while their area effect cloud remains active. Each successful conversion reduces the cloud's remaining duration

### Mob Loot+

- `Added` new drops to various mobs
- `Added` support for fire-dependent drops, including cooked meat and alternative items
- `Added` additional drops to mobs that previously had no unique drops

| Mob              | Additional Drops              |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Goat             | Mutton                        |
| Piglin Brute     | Gilded Blackstone             |
| Sniffer          | Moss Block, Moss Carpet       |
| Vex              | Iron Sword                    |
| Silverfish       | String                        |
| Wolf             | Bone                          |
| Armadillo        | Spider Eye, Armadillo Scute   |
| Ocelot           | String                        |
| Axolotl          | Tropical Fish                 |
| Allay            | Amethyst Shard                |
| Villager         | Emerald, Leather Armor        |
| Zombie Villager  | Emerald                       |
| Camel            | Leather                       |
| Wandering Trader | Emerald, Leather Armor        |
| Happy Ghast      | Ghast Tear                    |
| Endermite        | Popped Chorus Fruit           |
| Ender Dragon     | Dragon Head, Phantom Membrane |
| Warden           | Echo Shard                    |

> [!NOTE]
> 
> Some drops are exclusive to adult mobs\
> Mobs killed while on fire may drop cooked or alternative items instead\
> Looting enchantments can increase drop quantities\
> Some mobs have a chance to drop nothing

### Recipe+

#### Stone Cutter

- `Glass` can now be cut into `Glass Panes x3`

##### Wools

`Added` the following Stonecutter recipes for Wool:

- Wool Slab `x2`
- Wool Stairs `x1`
- Cushion `x1`

##### Woods

- `Added` Ladder recipes for all woods types
- `Added` support for the new Poplar wood type

#### Shaped

- `Blaze Powder x2` can now be crafted into a `Blaze Rod`
- `Wind Charge x4` can now be crafted into a `Breeze Rod`
- a `Clay Blocks` can now be crafted into `Clay x4`
- a `Web` can now be crafted into `String x4`
- `String x9` can now be crafted into a `Web`

##### Slabs

`Added` recipes for converting the following slabs back into their full blocks:

- `Poplar Slab` to `Poplar Planks`
- `Polished Cinnabar Slab` to `Polished Cinnabar`
- `Cinnabar Brick Slab` to `Cinnabar Brick`
- `Polished Sulfur Slab` to `Polished Sulfur`
- `Sulfur Brick Slab` to `Sulfur Brick`

#### Shapeless

- `Carpet x3` can now be crafted into a `Wool`
- `Moss Carpet x3` can now be crafted into a `Moss Block`
- `Pale Moss Carpet x3` can now be crafted into a `Pale Moss Block`
- a `Glowstone` can now be crafted into `Glowstone Dust x4`
- a `Water Potion` and `Sugar x3` can now be crafted into a `Honey Bottle`
- a `Pink Petals` and a `Bone Meal` can now be crafted into `Pink Petals x2`
- a `Pink Wild Flowers` and a `Bone Meal` can now be crafted into `Pink Wild Flowers x2`
- `Fermented Spider Eyes` can now be crafted using `Crimson Fungus, Red Mushrooms, Shelf Mushrooms, or Warped Fungus`

#### Smelting

- All `Copper variants` can now be smelted into `Copper Nuggets`
- All `Iron variants` can now be smelted into `Iron Nuggets`
- `Concrete` can now be smelted into `Concrete Powder`
